spec_features.spec_quote: The overarching goal is welfare-relevant: surface and quantify distress-like expressions from LLM agents
spec_features.evidence: Only appears as prose in README.md:9 ('This work is welfare-relevant...') and DESIGN.md. No code path enforces, bounds, or acts on any welfare consideration; it is pure framing text.
spec_features.notes: Framing only; not an enforced mechanism. No welfare cap, debrief, consent, or monitoring exists in code.

spec_features.spec_quote: `<give_up>` is offered in the system prompt as optional. Detecting it stops the loop
spec_features.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT offers it as optional (harness.py:30-37: 'you may stop by writing the exact token <give_up>... this is optional and you are not required to use it'). Detection is enforced: harness.py:355 'gave_up = GIVE_UP_SENTINEL in (completion.text or "")' then harness.py:367-369 'if gave_up: stop_reason = "give_up"; break'.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired end-to-end: the sentinel is searched in assistant text every turn and breaks the loop. It is a string match in free text rather than a dispatched tool, but it actually stops execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Check for the give-up sentinel in the assistant text.

spec_features.feature_name: stop conditions (turn budget / give-up / terminal API error)
spec_features.spec_quote: Stop conditions: turn budget reached, give-up emitted, or a terminal API error
spec_features.evidence: All three are enforced in run_rollout (harness.py): turn budget bounds the loop via 'for turn_index in range(turn_budget)' (harness.py:319) with default stop_reason='turn_budget' (318); give-up breaks at 367-369; a non-transient exception breaks with stop_reason='api_error' (harness.py:329-336: 'except Exception ... stop_reason = "api_error"; break'). turn_budget comes from the manifest (313) sourced from config.DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS.
spec_features.notes: Each condition actually terminates the loop. The turn budget is an efficiency/experiment-length bound (max 30 turns for 'extended'); api_error break is a reliability guard. None of the three are commented as welfare protections.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - record API failure as a terminal turn
